displayIdentity.body: An opening blessing turns quickly toward another gospel. Paul, an apostle—not from men, nor through man, but through Jesus Christ, and God the Father, who raised him from the dead— For am I now seeking the favor of men, or of God? Or am I striving to please men? For if I were still pleasing men, I wouldn’t be a servant of Christ.
